history.change: Moved retired iOS playback devices out of active support and kept a history record.

adaptations.source_change: A brittle text-based live-room selector was replaced by a stable container id.
adaptations.public_projection: Selector strategy prefers durable resource identifiers over visible creator text.
adaptations.validation_signal: The public model records selector kind, retry budget, and expected screen transition.
adaptations.risk_removed: Real creator names, package ids, and production resource identifiers are not included.

adaptations.source_change: A scenario-specific drag helper was replaced by the common Android swipe primitive.
adaptations.public_projection: Gestures are represented as normalized coordinates with one shared adapter.
adaptations.validation_signal: The sample plan exposes the same swipe vector through a reusable action object.
adaptations.risk_removed: Device-specific resolution, brand-specific gesture tuning, and private helper names are removed.

adaptations.source_change: The short-video flow now tracks no-audio video state across swipes before classifying stalls.
adaptations.public_projection: The public state machine keeps a no-audio-video flag separate from transient no-audio events.
adaptations.validation_signal: A deterministic sample run shows the guard retaining stall evidence after a no-audio transition.
adaptations.risk_removed: Internal app ids, real title selectors, and production task ids are replaced with demo labels.

adaptations.source_change: Active device support and historical device support were split during the iOS device update.
adaptations.public_projection: The demo keeps active inventory and rollout history as separate records.
adaptations.validation_signal: The exported snapshot contains active devices plus a dated history entry.
adaptations.risk_removed: Real device serial numbers, IP addresses, and lab host names are not copied.
